1661884818:
Ghrinitshahara

Ghrinitshahara is the capital of the Rampore Isles in the Shackles. The busy town is located on the central island of the archipelago, and as of 4712 AR it was famous for its large harbor and shipyards, where captured ships are repaired and refitted for sale to buyers across the Shackles, Sargava (now known as Vidrian), and the Inner Sea region.

As of 4712 AR, the cruel rakshasa Bedu Hanji ruled the Rampore Isles from his sprawling palace in Ghrinitshahara. The town once resembled the hamlets of the distant Kingdom of Vudra, home to the Vudrani mariners who established the settlement. When Bedu Hanji infiltrated Rampore's loose organization and became the master of the isles in 4662 AR, Ghrinitshahara became the center of a thriving business around the trade of humanoid slaves.⁠
1664091248:
Al'Hakam Estate

The Al'Hakam Estate is an impressive manor house on the edge of The Coins, near the Ascendant Court. Its grandeur is understandable, as it is not only the home of the influential merchant Aaqir al'Hakam but also of Emir Thalzar Gaatan, ambassador of Qadira. The couple lives there with their three adopted daughters, whom they adore.⁠
1674125758:
Cheeho the Talking Dog

Cheeho the Talking Dog is, as the name suggests, a stall where Cheeho entertains travelers with his stories, as he can communicate like a person. The truth is, he was once a human man, but after stealing an amulet from a burial site, he was cursed to live out his days as a dog, and here he is earning money to see if he can break the curse.⁠
1674393578:
Wreck of the Kaijitsu's Blossom

The Wreck of the Kaijitsu's Blossom is hardly identifiable as such, since crashing into the swamp and the passage of decades have caused nature to consume much of the ship. When the crew members heard that the crew of their sister ship, the Kaijitsu Star, had drowned, they risked leaving by land before the ship sank.⁠
1677219108:
Carent's Camp

Carent's Camp is a Varisian tent camp in the Dockway district of the city of Magnimar. It is run by Donal Carent, leader of the Wreckwash Blades, a Sczarni gang that specializes in information gathering and trade.

The camp contains numerous tents and other temporary structures, although Donal Carent reserves the best one for himself. Carent's Camp also recently was home to the Tower Girls, another Sczarni gang who was forced out after a disagreement developed between them and the Wreckwash Blades.⁠
1685434418:
Felicity Vale

Felicity Vale is a valley in the Nesmian Plains in Nirmathas. In centuries past it was home to a Kellid town and a half-dozen smaller settlements, but all are now in ruin since a tyrant jelly took control of a hive of giant bees and began feeding on the human inhabitants. Swarms of mundane and giant bees have made the vale's natural ecosystem very productive with numerous fruit trees and flowers growing there. Despite its seemingly idyllic nature, many adventurers and lost wanderers who attempted to reap the vale's bounty roused the jelly's ire, were captured by giant bees, are became sealed in wax in their hive.⁠
1726148928:
Smoking Ruin

The Smoking Ruin is a unusual sight in the otherwise gilded and wealthy region of Katapesh's Dawn Gate: a smoking ruin of ash and burnt out buildings, once the site of businesses and homes. According to rumor, one night a portal opened up to the Elemental Plane of Fire, and through it a host of angry fire elementals poured. They destroyed the area, killing everyone and everything in the region. Locals have since referred to that night as the "Dawn Gate Apocalypse", and are quick to avoid the area, as the restless souls of the victims of the event haunt the ruin.

Businessmen and residents near the area have pooled together a fund to sponsor a brave group of adventurers to put to rest these poor wailing souls by finding and burying their bones, but thus fair none have been brave enough to take them up on it.⁠
1732428678:
Baghava

Baghava is one of the mahajanapadas that make up the sacred region of the Divine Garden at the eastern edge of the Impossible Kingdoms of Vudra. The city-state is located amongst mangrove forests on the region's southern coastline of the Embaral Ocean.⁠

Baghava is renowned for the huge temple and ashram complexes across its holdings and its vast beautiful gardens, all of which are guarded by minotaur-priests of Gaelata.⁠
1732474618:
Hurlandrun

Hurlandrun was a Nirmathi village located near the source of the Deepcut River in the Mindspin Mountains in the south-west of the country.⁠ The disaster that led to the village's destruction was not due to war, but to the actions of individuals. A powerful mage named Mahalagris lived a quiet life in the village until he was killed and then returned as a dangerous undead being. This, combined with an attempted robbery of his tomb, unleashed his wrath, and the destruction he unleashed razed the village to the ground.⁠
1737656708:
Minderhal's Anvil

Minderhal's Anvil is an ancient temple to the giant smith-god Minderhal located in the Iron Peaks on the shores of the Storval Deep. Built thousands of years ago⁠ in the Thassilonian nation of Shalast⁠ with the labor of enslaved rune and stone giants,⁠ the temple is dominated by enormous, cracked marble pillars, a gigantic forge-altar, and a stone statue of Minderhal seated on his throne looking out over the Storval Deep with his chin resting on his fist. Few modern giants visit this old site, and the immense furnace, traditionally fed by the bodies of convicted criminals, stands cold.⁠⁠
1753579328:
Salhar Estate

The Salhar Estate is where the Grand Ambassador of Osirion, Dremdhet Salhar, lives surrounded by walls and iron gates, with a personal guard patrolling the area to prevent intruders from entering.⁠
1760057198:
Purewater Home

The Purewater Home is an orphanage that takes in the most unfortunate children in The Puddles while also serving as the base of operations for the local Firebrands cell, run by Hope, the building's owner. The place is relatively safe and dry thanks to Hope's efforts and reputation, and the children are instructed in political issues by helping with acts of vandalism that keep them occupied and away from more serious crime.⁠
1766614178:
Khundurai

Khundurai is a city in the Ketz Desert of Qadira that is renowned for its luxurious and exquisite carpets that are exported across the whole of Golarion. While most of these carpets only serve as gorgeous floor coverings, if one knows the right merchant, it is possible to purchase one of the fabled flying carpets so well known outside of Qadira.⁠
1767537818:
Jungle Runners

Jungle Runners is a shop where Erandlon and Bujkis Tallwoman offer their services as guides for explorers or nobles who wish to venture into the jungle, whether to find a ruin or bring a dinosaur skull back home. No one knows their way around the dangerous inland jungle better than they do.⁠
1771927988:
Arodennama

The Arodennama, a massive statue of Aroden, stretches 90 feet above its base on Aroden's Rise in Westcrown. Created from massive blocks of white marble, it is the oldest structure in Westcrown and, perhaps, even in all of Avistan. The statue faces the river and Westcrown Island, with the chest aligned to stand if the first rays of sunlight in the morning and the last at night. A massive silver-inlaid winged-eye symbol of Aroden stretches to the sleeves and under the arms.

A variety of structures of many ages surround the statue, originally built in the expectation of his arrival, most now lie neglected and vacant. In contrast, even after a century's neglect, no signs of tarnish or wear mar the silver eye of Aroden across the breast.⁠⁠ Within the statue are a number of chambers originally designed as places to pray and pay homage to Aroden. Most troubling to many of his clergy is that no residual magic or lingering curse remains here from Aroden's demise. After all, if Aroden could not even leave his blessing here, the place where his prophesies foretold he would return to the world, then his demise is even more definite and profound.⁠

The area surrounding the statue is a large plaza known as the Vacant Throne, and encompasses several buildings (now abandoned). The area has been described as having a feel of ancient but abandoned majesty.⁠
1786211788:
Founder's Peak

Founder's Peak is located on the east bank of Southrun, being the highest point in the area. It was named after Founder Adel, who is said to have cut down the trees he found there to create a boat to cross the river, and from its heights saw how the city should be built. The area is full of farms and olive orchards tended by generations of druids of the Arthrugge family, who maintain political neutrality.⁠
1791087338:
Pantheon of Many

The Pantheon of Many is a temple devoted to almost all of the main deities of the Inner Sea region located in the South Shore district of the Varisian city of Korvosa.

The Pantheon of Many contains shrines to all the traditional core deities of the Inner Sea except for Gorum, Lamashtu, and Rovagug. Neither Cayden Cailean nor Desna had a shrine within the Pantheon when it was built, but when huge crowds of their worshippers blockaded the Pantheon before its opening, their shrines were swiftly added.⁠

Each deity's shrine is equally sized and equally respected. Clerics and priests of each religion are allowed to practice their personal rites and rituals without interference as long as they abide by the laws of Korvosa, and regardless of whether the religion is evil or chaotic. The only restriction is that no sacrifices, human or animal, are allowed.⁠
1797218388:
Anthusis

Anthusis, formerly called Eleder, is the capital of Vidrian and the country's only deepwater port.⁠⁠⁠
1799797968:
Valanyne

Valanyne is a town located in the far east of Kyonin, near the Sellen River. The village was unremarkable until Godsrain, which severed all communication. Anyone who has gone looking for the town or its inhabitants has returned empty-handed.⁠
1801730288:
The Smoke Lady

The Smoke Lady is a black and purple shop where the Smoke Lady tells fortunes for travelers for a fee. Children can be heard outside advertising, and inside, the woman is hidden behind a smokescreen that obscures her face as she foretells the destiny of the clients.⁠
1804430218:
Devil's Elbow Harbor

The Devil's Elbow Harbor is located in the only safe place for a ship to dock on the island, as the rest of the coast is full of reefs. The island's inhabitants built piers and buildings here, which are now just ruins and abandoned stone walls.⁠
1805852818:
Sueda Lodge

Sueda Lodge is a Pathfinder lodge in southeastern Katapesh that aids Pathfinders and other explorers searching for ancient Osirian artifacts, and also serves as a repository for information.⁠
1809739998:
Gilded Orrery

The Gilded Orrery is a magic shop located in the Heights District of Korvosa.⁠⁠⁠ Gasta Weagra is the owner of the Gilded Orrery. A plump woman with gray hair, Gasta is the niece of Toff Ornelos, the headmaster of the Academae, the city's most prestigious school of magic, and rarely sells to anyone not connected with it.⁠
1810322368:
Sampadabad

Sampadabad is a ruined city in the north-west of Vudra's storied central region known as the Cradle. Sampadabad was not a Vudrani city but rather one built by nagas.⁠
1816727678:
Tomb of the Thousand Tusks

The Tomb of the Thousand Tusks is a crypt located in the southernmost Barrier Wall mountains on the border between the Mwangi Expanse and the Sodden Lands.⁠ It is believed to be the lair of the adhukait asura Kaisadvaisad, who guards the skull of the empyreal lord Shei Five Dawns.⁠
1830106058:
Jainai

Jainai is a sarangay city on the southern portion of Bukorang island in Minata.⁠
1832374378:
Battle of Screaming Tree

The Battle of Screaming Tree is a historic conflict that took place in the eastern Blood Plains of the Hold of Belkzen, just west of the Flood Road in 4051 AR.⁠ It forever changed the region and the history of the struggle over central Belkzen. The Screaming Tree, now located at this site, serves as a constant reminder of the pain wrought on this battlefield.⁠
1839853018:
Ahn'Selota

The mysterious pyramid of Ahn'Selota, also known as the fabled Pact Stone Pyramid,⁠ is located near the ruins of Tumen in the Scorpion Coast region of northeastern Osirion. The pyramid is somehow linked with the magical pact that united the Four Pharaohs of Ascension more than 6,000 years ago. It is said that Ahn'Selota houses the secret of the pharaohs' powerful pact that joined their fates.⁠⁠
1866276608:
Riba

Riba is a small town on the Marbleflow River in the Irrisen province of Hoarwood.⁠
1869734028:
Mercenary League Headquarters

The Mercenary League Headquarters is where the organization's generals, its most powerful and influential members, reside. This black building stands in stark contrast to the district's opulence, and mercenaries can be seen and heard planning and coordinating global campaigns, as well as patrolling the city as guards. Commander Sarissa Kurst directs operations here, and the Whispering Tyrant's presence on the lake is creating a noticeable shortage of resources.⁠
1871850368:
Fierce Stripe

The Fierce Stripe is a shop where all of Absalom's badger needs are met. Lady Chesne of House Yuriel runs the shop, acquiring unique breeds of badgers for adoption by the residents of Westgate, where the animal has supplanted dogs and cats as a pet. The Tri-Stripe Society shops there and meets weekly to drink tea and discuss the town's badger competitions.⁠
1884739868:
Quent

Quent is the second-largest settlement in the Shackles after Port Peril. It is on the north coast of Motaku Isle, the Shackles' largest island. Sheltered from the storm by the large barrier islands of its picturesque bay, Quent is known as the finest deepwater port in the region. Moreover, Quent is also known among the sailors as the liveliest and most welcoming of the ports.⁠⁠⁠
1887315608:
Vargas Swamp

Vargas Swamp is the largest swamp in the predominantly dry country of Katapesh, spanning almost 30 miles in length and half that in width. Located in north-central Katapesh, myriad trees, herbs, and grasses grow there, attracting herbivores and their predators. A small tribe of lizardfolk makes its home here as well.

Vargas Swamp also contains numerous ruins and the skeletons of old villages (such as Slither Cove), that were swallowed by the rising water levels, which can fluctuate unpredictably. Some blame this strange occurrence on a green dragon said to live in the swamp, although this has never been proven.⁠
1893428858:
Mantis Stone

The Mantis Stones are a series of menhirs outside the city of Ilizmagorti, which are linked to the predatory forces that dominate the island. When the Achaekek cult arrived on the island and found that these monuments were linked to giant mantises, they saw it as a sign from their god that they were on the right path by relocating to the island.⁠
1896873998:
Zeibo

The town of Zeibo was built by elven and half-elven citizens of the shogunate of Ushinawa Isles in the Shackles. Its wooden buildings are constructed around the thick trees of the isle in an almost organic fashion. Zeibo is known for the Petal Seminary, a small school for geisha that has also combined aspects of elven culture. The elegant school attracts bards from all over the Inner Sea region. The Petal Seminary's respected instructor is Kazumi Nanbatwa.⁠
1902638518:
Yardarm Bridge

Yardarm Bridge connects the Alcasar and Redshore districts, spanning the Red River. The Blood Watch hangs captured criminals from the bridge as a stark reminder of the city's crime.⁠
1921490098:
Gutless Griffon

The Gutless Griffon is a tavern in the Ivy District that has become very popular thanks to its owner, Fronsac Shimm. He chooses the food and the music, but above all, it's his lively attitude that makes him so appealing. He introduces himself to new patrons by telling anecdotes or serving drinks. His popularity even earned him a seat on the Grand Council, giving him a rags-to-riches story that only makes him more likable.⁠ The establishment boasts a taproom and balconies furnished with the finest furniture, and bards who are excluded from the Street Performers and Actors' Guild are welcome. Shimm has a mutual animosity with Alain Always, even though they were once best friends. They respect each other and generally don't interfere in each other's affairs, but since the Brotherhood of Abadar often hangs out at the tavern, the rift between them only widens. One of the first things you notice upon entering is its large fireplace and hearth, where the craziest stories from all over the Inner Sea are told.⁠
1922249228:
Wingless Rock

Wingless Rock is a small, sparsely vegetated island off the west coast of Nidal. Local fishermen avoid it because there is nothing to catch, and there are also strong superstitions about bad luck. The Aspis Consortium used the island for smuggling artifacts from Nidal, but the operation was shut down by the Pathfinder Society.⁠

What few people know is that beneath the island lie laboratories dedicated to Conference Z research.⁠
1936904028:
Qaharid

Qaharid, also called the Turquoise City, is a major mining city in the Maharev region of Qadira.⁠⁠
1937476708:
Pure Temple of the Maharajah

The Pure Temple of the Maharajah is built over the spring that is the source of the River Sald in the small eastern hills of Jalmeray. The structure is white and gold and is maintained by bound genies and a huge number of slaves and their duty-bound overseers. The temple is dedicated to Khiben-Sald, the ancient ruler who founded Jalmeray. Every four years, thousands of people make their way up the Sald from the city of Niswan to pay respects to his memory. Even though the maharajah is not buried here (and some claim that he is still alive), the people treat the Pure Temple as if it was his final resting place.⁠
1947199928:
Spiral Shrine

The Spiral Shrine is a temple of Pharasma that was among the first to be rebuilt in the Precipice Quarter after the earthquake that shook the district. Hundreds of candles were placed in its alcoves to honor the memory of those whose bodies could not be recovered from the rubble, and the residents of Beldrin's Bluff donated significantly to consecrate the temple and enable them to hire undead hunters. It is one of the few places in the district where divine magical healing can be obtained, and the abandoned mansions in the area have been converted into apartments where a community of duskwalkers lives, fighting the undead. For this reason, the district's living residents hold them in great reverence, bowing their heads when they see one or offering them food and water when asked.⁠
1947886388:
Fort Dagh

Fort Dagh is located at the summit of a mountain peak south of Tar-Kazmukh and overlooks the Great Pass of the northwestern Five Kings Mountains. It is renowned for its view despite a reputation among soldiers as a hardship posting, and its commander is First Captain Hannah Drasten, a rare human among the Five Kings Mountains' military leaders.⁠

A nearby peak bears the Carved Kings sculpture of King Kazmukh of Doggadth, which also overlooks the Great Pass.⁠
1953419538:
Fort Liberthane

Fort Liberthane is the only settlement in the tiny River Kingdom of Liberthane founded by the revolutionary "Young Knight" Achille Parsall in 4689 AR. The small fortress was the base of operations of a notorious bandit before Parsall and his followers seized control of it. The fort is home to approximately 50 soldiers. A number of farming families have settled around the fort.⁠
1955560938:
Tomb of the Bound Sphinx

The Tomb of the Bound Sphinx is a pyramid shaped tomb constructed in the Barrier Wall mountains. It was constructed in -1116 AR by Pharaoh Kenaton to be his final resting place, but was unknowingly built over an underground chamber into which it collapsed a few decades after construction. This destroyed some of the treasure it contained and shifted some of its passages, making exploration difficult.

As well as the final resting place for Kenaton, the tomb also contains a magical prison which contains Hephtethnet the Reaver, a hieracosphinx who terrorized Osirion during Kenaton's life.⁠

Trivardum

Planepierce Spire

The Planepierce Spire is a tower filled with laboratories and warehouses, all belonging to Cyran Androtus. Only those invited by him can enter; the doors are only opened rarely to obtain supplies from the outside. There are rumors that extraplanar creatures are also bringing supplies from other planes inside, and given Cyran's involvement, this is quite likely.⁠

Cathedral of Abadar

4 locations:

2002012558:
Nature's Glass

Nature's Glass is a small, natural pool of water deep within the Fangwood and to the west of Crossfen.⁠ Its surface reflects like a mirror, and a legend has grown up around it that the water reflects the true nature of those who gaze into it. This phenomenon has attracted the attention of some fey, among them Leeta, a swan maiden determined to protect the waters by drowning those who try to poison them.⁠
2011558068:
Al'Faran's Steel Restaurant

Doubtlessly one of Katapesh's strangest weapon shops, Al'Faran's Steel Restaurant is located in the Inner City area, but bears more resemblance to an eatery that a swordsmith's. Customers are taken to a table and presented with a selection of beverages and food, then given a list of the unique weapons that have been created by the master weaponsmith Diyab Al'Faran. He crafts bespoke weapons from the finest Drumish steel to give them near-perfect balance. As a result, his weapons cost substantially more than normal weapons.

While Al'Faran doesn't sell magical weapons, he does sell magical oils and alchemical substances that enhance weapons, such as silversheen or oil of keen edge.⁠
2012525108:
Jeggare Museum

In the city of Korvosa, located in the region of Varisia, the Jeggare Museum is only rivaled by the Museum of Ages in Magnimar.⁠
2026349368:
House of Withered Blossoms

The House of Withered Blossoms is a pagoda located in a blighted area of ​​the Forest of Spirits. It was the place where the forest kami imprisoned the oni Anamurumon and his forces to prevent them from continuing to wreak havoc in the region. With the fall of the Lung Wa empire and the ensuing chaos, the oni managed to escape their confinement, leaving one of their own, Munasukaru, to defend the pagoda in case any kami dared to enter to see if they were still inside. The aranea Akinosa also took an interest in the pagoda and spent decades attacking it without much success.⁠

Wreck of the Kaijitsu's Blossom

2039602838:
New Jelheg

New Jelheg is a very small settlement in southern Druma.⁠
2042000748:
Avendale

Avendale is the capital city of the River Kingdom of Touvette.
2050163358:
Totra

Totra, founded in -2587 AR by the Conquering Pharaoh An-Hepsu II, is the largest of Osirion's ports outside Sothis. The city is often seen not only as a symbol of the country's power, but a symbol of its excesses as well. When the An Dynasty subjugated what would become Thuvia and Rahadoum with its fleets (known as the Great Atoqua), Totra saw an influx of slaves who would build the country's pyramids and monuments. The city's under-classes and nobility are still almost exclusively Garundi, and harbor suspicion and prejudice against Keleshites for their millennia of foreign rule. Following the death of the Fallen Pharaoh and the Qadiran invasion of 1532 AR, many of Totra's ancient monuments were toppled by the invaders. In a turnaround, the city's harbor now hosts a red granite statue of An-Hepsu II, built on a new island created from the toppled statues of Qadiran satraps.⁠

The city is loyal to Khemet III, but the nobility bemoan the heavy taxation they suffer.⁠

Detmer

The main shipyard that powers the naval arm of Druma's mercantile empire, the city of Detmer is located on a rocky outcrop that is thrust out into the Gulf of Accord on Lake Encarthan. It is from here that the barges and caravels that cross the lake and ensure Druma's wealth are launched. The city is famous for its Sapphire Harbor which, thanks to Druma's incredible wealth, is a more literal description than most think.⁠ Very little trade (at least by Drumish standards) takes place in Detmer, as it is primarily focused on shipbuilding and maintenance. The Drumish Navy is headquartered here as well, providing security in the Gulf of Accord and wherever else Drumish merchant ships travel in the pursuit of trade.⁠

Usher's Hall

The Usher's Hall is one of the most important buildings in the city of Magnimar as it is home to the Council of Ushers, which is one of Magnimar's ruling bodies. Located in the Capital District, the governmental hub of Magnimar, the Usher's Hall sits opposite the famous Indros cul Vydrarch monument at the centre of the district.

The Usher's Hall is an impressive building, covered with ornate sculptures (as befitting such an important building in the City of Monuments).⁠ The building contains enough space to house all 117 members of the Council of Ushers.⁠

Frisky Unicorn

Citadel Crest ward, in the Heights District, is the only ward in Korvosa having no inns by law. People requiring overnight stays, instead, have the choice from three bed and breakfast establishments, all of which are owned by nobles. In order of price, they are:

  • the Frisky Unicorn, the cheapest;
  • Upslope House; and
  • Tenna's, the most expensive.

In order of size, Tenna's is the smallest and Upslope House the largest.⁠⁠⁠
